books.title: Intermezzo
books.author: Sally Rooney
books.synopsis: Two brothers in Dublin, Peter, a successful barrister, and Ivan, a young chess prodigy, are left reeling after their father's death, each entangled in a complicated relationship with an older or younger woman while their own bond frays and slowly reforms.

mentions.author: Ludwig Wittgenstein
mentions.note: (epigraph) But don’t you feel grief now? (‘But aren’t you now playing chess?’) —LUDWIG WITTGENSTEIN, Philosophical Investigations

mentions.author: Bobby Fischer
mentions.note: What’s the book? Peter asks. My 60 Memorable Games.
